payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what happened to the mug requested to be moved, and where is it relative to the headphones?
node.criteria: Assess the requested mug using visual correspondence between source and edited images without assuming unprovided attributes. Complete only when evidence supports that the source mug was relocated and is now to the right of the headphones; a newly appearing mug to the right alone does not establish relocation if the source mug remains or a duplicate/residual is evident. Partial when the source mug shows movement toward the right but has not reached the right of the headphones, or when relocation is evident but the requested final relation is not achieved. Absent when there is no progress toward moving the mug right. Unknown when the mug's correspondence or movement cannot be established from the images. Do not infer progress from unrelated edits.
node.binding: the mug requested to be moved; the headphones

outcome.description: Move the mug to the right of the headphones.
